summary: Write the DeepSeek-V4.1 compressor state ring during decode
details: Circular-buffer KV groups take a worker slot mapping into their ring block, so DeepSeek-V4.1 writes its compressor partial-state ring for every real row and decode no longer drifts from the model as generation lengthens.
Corrects vllm-926: mapping ring positions alone left circular groups without a slot mapping, so the ring was still never written.
